title: Connect Claude to NotebookLM for the Ultimate AI Workflow #shorts  #ai #technology
description:
Are you tired of explaining your project goals, style, and context every single time you open a new Claude chat? You are not alone. By default, every new Claude session starts from scratch—but there is a free way to fix it.

In this video, I reveal a mind-blowing workflow that gives Claude AI "infinite memory." By connecting Claude to Google's NotebookLM using a free, open-source MCP server, your AI assistant will finally remember everything you tell it!

How to set up this infinite memory workflow:

Step 1: Create a NotebookLM notebook to act as your AI's permanent memory bank.

Step 2: Add a "wrap-up skill" that automatically saves every completed conversation into that notebook.

Step 3: Give Claude a simple rule to check the notebook before it answers any new questions that depend on your past work.

Now, every new chat starts with full context! Your AI doesn't just generate text; it actually learns and gets more useful the more you use it.
